title: Faisal Town Block A Islamabad – Map, Plots & Prices
description: Explore Faisal Town Block A in Phase 1/F-18 Islamabad, including map guidance, plots for sale, price factors, location checks and buyer verification.
h1: Faisal Town Block A – Phase 1, F-18 Islamabad
intro:
Faisal Town Block A is an established residential block of Faisal Town Phase 1 in Sector F-18, Islamabad. Buyers commonly compare plots here based on plot size, street location, road width, corner or main-road position, possession status and proximity to access points.

If you are considering a plot or house in Block A, use the relevant Phase 1 map together with an on-site inspection and current resale inventory before making a decision. Block A should not be confused with the sectors and enclaves marketed under Faisal Town Phase 2.
body:
## Faisal Town Block A overview

Faisal Town Block A is part of Faisal Town Phase 1 in F-18 Islamabad. It is primarily relevant to buyers searching for established residential plots, resale opportunities, houses and a location that can be inspected physically before purchase.

When comparing properties in Block A, do not rely on the block name alone. Two plots of the same size can have noticeably different asking prices because of exact street position, road width, corner or main-road location, access, possession, nearby construction and outstanding dues.

For a serious purchase decision, compare the exact plot rather than treating every Block A property as identical.

## Faisal Town Block A location and map

Block A is located within Faisal Town Phase 1/F-18 Islamabad.

Before visiting a property, match the plot to the correct Phase 1 map and confirm the street and plot number. This is especially important where online listings use shortened location descriptions or where different Faisal Town phases are mentioned without enough detail.

During a site visit, check how practical the route is from the main access point, the condition and width of the street, nearby construction, surrounding occupancy and the location of community or commercial areas relevant to you.

A map should be used for initial shortlisting, but the physical location should always be checked before making an offer.

## Plot sizes in Faisal Town Block A

Current resale inventory commonly includes 30 x 60 residential plots, often marketed at approximately 8 marla.

However, buyers should verify the dimensions of the specific property from the allotment, transfer or ownership documents rather than relying only on a portal listing.

When comparing two plots of a similar advertised size, also check:

- exact dimensions
- street width
- corner or non-corner position
- main-road or internal-street location
- possession status
- outstanding dues
- surrounding development
- access from the main road

The physical position of the plot can be just as important as its advertised size.

## Faisal Town Block A plots for sale

Block A has an active resale market, with residential plots regularly appearing in Faisal Town Phase 1/F-18 listings.

Availability changes frequently, so this page should not be treated as a fixed inventory list. A plot available today may no longer be available after a few days, while new resale options may enter the market.

Before comparing asking prices, try to compare properties of the same approximate size and similar location.

A lower asking price does not automatically mean better value if the property has weaker access, outstanding dues, a less desirable street position or documentation issues.

Before making an offer, confirm:

- plot number
- exact location
- dimensions
- ownership documents
- transfer position
- outstanding dues
- possession status
- any special-location premium
- current physical condition of the surrounding area

## Faisal Town Block A prices

There is no single reliable price for every Block A plot because the exact location can materially affect the asking price.

When comparing current Block A listings, consider:

- plot size and dimensions
- street and road width
- corner position
- main-road or boulevard position
- distance from the main access
- possession and development status
- outstanding dues
- surrounding construction and occupancy
- seller urgency
- documentation and transfer readiness

For a realistic comparison, review several recently available plots of the same size and similar location rather than relying on an old average price.

If one plot is significantly more expensive than another, check whether the premium is being asked because of a corner position, wider road, better access or another special location feature.

## Who Faisal Town Block A may suit

Block A may suit buyers who prefer an established Phase 1 location and want to compare existing resale plots based on actual streets, access and surroundings.

It may appeal to buyers who want to physically inspect the exact property before deciding rather than evaluating a future-sector booking only from marketing material.

For family use, compare the street environment, nearby construction, road access and practical distance to the services you expect to use.

For resale or investment, consider how easily the exact location can be explained to future buyers, the demand for the relevant plot size and whether the property's position offers any meaningful advantage over nearby alternatives.

## Is Faisal Town Block A good for investment?

Investment suitability depends on the individual property rather than the Block A name alone.

A well-positioned plot with clear documentation, practical access and a location that is easy for future buyers to identify may be more attractive than another plot in the same block with weaker access or a less desirable position.

Before purchasing for investment, compare:

- current asking prices
- recent resale activity
- competing plots of the same size
- road and street position
- surrounding development
- documentation status
- likely buyer demand
- total acquisition and transfer cost

Avoid buying only because a property is described as being in a particular block. The exact location and purchase price still matter.

## Block A house versus plot decision

A plot inquiry and a house inquiry should be handled separately.

A plot buyer mainly needs to verify location, dimensions, street position, dues, ownership and transfer status.

A house buyer should check all of those points as well as:

- construction quality
- seepage or dampness
- electrical and plumbing condition
- utilities
- finishing quality
- layout
- ventilation
- repair requirements
- renovation cost

If you are open to both houses and plots, shortlist them separately.

A house may appear more expensive because construction is already included, while a plot may require significant additional construction cost before it becomes suitable for living.

## What to check before buying in Block A

Before making a serious offer on a Block A property, complete both documentation and physical checks.

First confirm that the property is actually in Faisal Town Phase 1/F-18 Block A.

Then verify the exact plot number, street, dimensions, ownership documents, current dues and transfer requirements.

During the site visit, check:

- exact plot location
- street width
- surrounding construction
- accessibility
- nearby occupied houses
- road condition
- any visible drainage or level issues
- corner or main-road status
- nearby commercial or community activity

For resale properties, it is also sensible to understand why the owner is selling and whether there are any pending dues, transfer issues or other costs that could affect the final purchase amount.

## Block A vs Block B and Block C

Do not choose between Phase 1 blocks from the block name alone.

Compare the actual property location, road access, surrounding occupancy, plot position, current resale supply and total purchase cost.

Block A may have one type of inventory available while Block B or Block C may offer a better-positioned property at a similar overall budget.

If you are still shortlisting Phase 1, compare Block A with Block B and Block C before arranging final site visits.

The objective should be to identify the strongest individual property for your budget rather than assuming that one block is automatically better for every buyer.

## Faisal Town Block A map and site-visit checklist

Use the Faisal Town Phase 1/F-18 map to identify Block A before visiting the property.

Then confirm the exact street and plot physically.

During your visit, check:

- route from the main access point
- street width
- road condition
- nearby construction
- surrounding occupancy
- plot orientation
- corner or non-corner status
- nearby commercial activity
- ease of access
- any visible site-level concerns

If possible, visit at more than one time of day before making a major purchase decision.

A quiet street at one time may have different traffic or activity during other hours.

## Do not confuse Block A with Faisal Town Phase 2

Faisal Town Block A on this page refers to Faisal Town Phase 1/F-18 Islamabad.

It should not be confused with Faisal Town Phase 2.

Phase 2 uses its own sector and enclave references on this website. If an agent or property listing says Faisal Town Phase 2, ask for the exact sector, enclave and master-plan reference instead of assuming it refers to Block A.

This distinction is important when comparing maps, prices, resale inventory and development information.
